entry.title: A little water to pour
entry.invitation: A small jug, a little water, and a turn to pour—with help nearby.
entry.summary: If your child is interested in pouring and can manage a small jug, offer a little water with a cloth nearby. Stay available to help.
entry.cue: Notice an interest in tipping, filling, or pouring, and whether the jug feels manageable in their hands.
detail: A small amount of water makes the invitation easier to share. Davies includes pouring in ordinary family life, with a little jug and something ready for spills.
Show the movement slowly, then leave room for a turn. Your child may want to repeat just the pouring or the wiping. You can help with the rest.
steps: Set out a small jug with a little water, a glass, and a cloth or sponge for spills.
Show one slow pour, then offer a turn.

displayContext.footer: You don’t need a different home. Start with what you have.
